_doc: Real-voice segments of SERIE.md §4: word times relative to the segment in (source seconds - in). s = audible onset of the first phone (stop: release burst; fricative: frication; nasal: murmur; vowel: voicing), e = end of the last phone. pre = start of a voiced-stop voice bar before s; vowel = first vowel onset; syl = syllable onsets (last = stressed syllable). Measured by hand on 1-ms spectrograms of work/vN_vocals.wav (voice/check/rvz_*.png), ±10-20 ms; ASR (faster-whisper large-v3) gives the words and their order.
